/* GENERATED FILE. Edit the generator that writes it, never this.
 *
 * A MOD CANNOT SHIP AN FMOD BANK, so every clip below is a loose OGG resolved
 * through ZomboidFileSystem by FMODManager.loadSound. `event =` could only name an
 * event that already exists in a vanilla bank.
 *
 * EVERY VALUE CARRIES A TRAILING COMMA, INCLUDING THE LAST. ScriptParser.readBlock
 * emits a value only when it reaches a ',' and returns immediately on '}', so a
 * final key without one is silently dropped. A live workshop mod ships exactly that
 * bug today.
 *
 * distanceMin and distanceMax go through Integer.parseInt: a float throws and takes
 * the whole script object with it. There is no `priority` key.
 *
 * Names are prefixed because GameSounds keys ONE flat map on the bare name and
 * ignores the module, so a later-loading mod with the same name replaces ours.
 */
